gate: Three consecutive adjacent-window comparisons: median query sum ratio within [1/1.05,1.05], and every individual-query median ratio within [1/1.10,1.10]. Both attached modules must pass at the same cutoff in a repetition. Select the first jointly passing cutoff without inspecting holdout timings.
holdout_validation: Compare the first and last 16-cycle windows of the following 48 cycles with the same sum and individual-query ratio limits. If this fails, label the pair unstable; do not search for a later cutoff. If no eligible gate passes, label the pair unstable. Report an aggregate timing ratio only if all three pairs in a profile pass.
diagnostics: Four separate off compilation-logging JVMs: default/batch times baseline/candidate; excluded from timing comparisons.
